## Checklist

<!-- Delete the groups that do not apply. -->

### Data, auth, tenancy <!-- apps/api/src/db, RLS, identity -->

- [ ] Threats stated above, and a negative isolation test ships with the change
- [ ] Migrations generated by Drizzle; any manual SQL follows the `apps/api/src/db/AGENTS.md` comment contract
- [ ] No secret, token, or server-resolved host path reaches logs, errors, model context, or owner output

### API contract

- [ ] `openapi.json` and the web client regenerated (`pnpm generate:api-client`); a second generation is a clean diff

### UI

- [ ] Stories added or updated and their tests pass; preview URLs posted in a PR comment
- [ ] Only shared primitives and semantic tokens (`DESIGN.md`)

### Product contract

- [ ] OpenSpec proposal approved; this layer's `tasks.md` boxes ticked
- [ ] Operator docs, `CHANGELOG.md` entry, and `ROADMAP.md` removals included

### General

- [ ] Self-reviewed the parent-relative diff against `REVIEW_GUIDE.md`
- [ ] CI green on the current head (or only `master`-red checks, named in a comment) before marking ready
- [ ] No debug, scratch, or unrelated code in the diff
- [ ] Delivery Project item added and its Status / Next action set
